item.title: Justin Timberlake sues Sag Harbor to block release of 2024 DWI body cam footage
item.description: The singer is suing Sag Harbor and its police department this week, seeking to prevent the public release of video tied to his June 18, 2024, driving while intoxicated arrest.

item.title: School closings and delays in NY, NJ, CT for Tuesday, March 3
item.description: Due to inclement weather and a wintery mix across the Tri-State area, several schools are delayed or closed Tuesday.

item.title: Diddy to be released earlier than expected after rehab program: Report
item.description: Diddy is currently being held at the Federal Correctional Institution Fort Dix in New Jersey, a minimum-security prison that houses about 3,000 inmates.

item.title: Plane makes emergency landing in Hudson River; all rescued, no deaths
item.description: Both occupants of a small aircraft that made an emergency landing in the Hudson River Monday evening have been rescued and are expected to recover, according to Orange County Executive Steve Neuhaus.

item.title: Congestion pricing program will continue, despite Trump administration's efforts
item.description: The federal government can not end New York's congestion pricing program, according to the ruling of a federal judge.
